_doc: OmaqBT's settings schema for qBittorrent 5.2.3's /app/preferences: the one source that qbt (through jq) and the Settings view (through the generated SettingsSchema.js) both read. After editing, run `node tools/gen-settings-schema.js` to regenerate SettingsSchema.js and tests/fixtures/settings-cases.json. keys is in display order. Each entry: section, group, label, help (one line), type (bool, int, float, speed [bytes/s], choice-int, choice-string, time [a composite], path, text, secret); optional unit, min, max, step (values must be multiples of it), sentinels ({value: label}, special values outside or at the edge of the range; for a path, "" is its only sentinel), choices ([{value, label}]), locked, readOnly (no setter in setPreferences), hidden (never shown, not even in Other), deferred (a later slice), multiline, secret, restart (qBittorrent's own UI says it requires a restart), confirm ({text, values?, byValue?}: ask first when the new value is one of values, or on every change without values; byValue maps a value (as a string) to the text used for it instead of text), dependsOn ({key, value}: dimmed unless key holds value, or one of value when it's an array), composite ({hour, min}: a time written as its two hidden member keys in one request). locked lists the keys qbt refuses to write (globs, * only); otherRefusedPatterns lists the unknown-key patterns the Other section refuses.

torrent_content_layout.label: Content layout
torrent_content_layout.help: How a new torrent's files are laid out: as the torrent has them, in a subfolder, or without one.

add_to_top_of_queue.label: Add to top of queue
add_to_top_of_queue.help: New torrents go to the top of the queue instead of the bottom.

add_stopped_enabled.label: Add torrents stopped
add_stopped_enabled.help: New torrents are added stopped, so they don't start until you start them.

torrent_stop_condition.label: Stop condition
torrent_stop_condition.help: Stop a new torrent once its metadata arrives or its files are checked.

merge_trackers.label: Merge trackers of duplicates
merge_trackers.help: Adding a torrent that already exists merges its trackers into the existing one.

auto_delete_mode.label: Delete .torrent files afterwards
auto_delete_mode.help: Delete the .torrent file once the torrent is added, or also when adding is cancelled.

confirm.text: The .torrent files you add are deleted from disk.

preallocate_all.label: Pre-allocate disk space
preallocate_all.help: Reserve the full size of every file when a download starts.

incomplete_files_ext.label: Add .!qB to incomplete files
incomplete_files_ext.help: Unfinished files carry a .!qB extension until they complete.

use_unwanted_folder.label: Keep unselected files in .unwanted
use_unwanted_folder.help: Files you skip are kept in a .unwanted folder instead of beside the others.

auto_tmm_enabled.label: Automatic torrent management
auto_tmm_enabled.help: New torrents use automatic management: their category decides where they're saved.

torrent_changed_tmm_enabled.label: Relocate when category changes
torrent_changed_tmm_enabled.help: Changing a torrent's category moves it to that category's path; off turns management off for it.

save_path_changed_tmm_enabled.label: Relocate when default path changes
save_path_changed_tmm_enabled.help: Changing the default save path moves the affected torrents; off turns management off for them.

category_changed_tmm_enabled.label: Relocate when category path changes
category_changed_tmm_enabled.help: Changing a category's save path moves its torrents; off turns management off for them.

use_category_paths_in_manual_mode.label: Category paths in manual mode
use_category_paths_in_manual_mode.help: Manually managed torrents still use their category's subfolder.

save_path.label: Default save path
save_path.help: Where new torrents are saved unless a category says otherwise.

temp_path_enabled.label: Keep incomplete torrents elsewhere
temp_path_enabled.help: Download into a separate folder and move files to the save path when done.

export_dir.label: Copy .torrent files to
export_dir.help: Keep a copy of every added .torrent file here. Empty turns it off.

export_dir_fin.label: Copy finished .torrent files to
export_dir_fin.help: Keep a copy of each finished torrent's .torrent file here. Empty turns it off.

scan_dirs.label: Watched folders
scan_dirs.help: Folders qBittorrent watches for new .torrent files. Deprecated in the API, so it isn't shown here.

excluded_file_names_enabled.label: Exclude file names
excluded_file_names_enabled.help: Skip files whose names match the patterns below when adding a torrent.

excluded_file_names.label: Excluded file names
excluded_file_names.help: One pattern per line, for example *.exe.

mail_notification_enabled.label: Email when done
mail_notification_enabled.help: Send an email when a download finishes.

mail_notification_sender.label: From
mail_notification_sender.help: The sender address on the email.

mail_notification_email.label: To
mail_notification_email.help: The address the email goes to.

mail_notification_smtp.label: SMTP server
mail_notification_smtp.help: The mail server that sends the email.

mail_notification_ssl_enabled.label: Use SSL
mail_notification_ssl_enabled.help: Connect to the SMTP server over SSL.

mail_notification_auth_enabled.label: SMTP authentication
mail_notification_auth_enabled.help: Log in to the SMTP server.

mail_notification_username.label: SMTP username
mail_notification_username.help: The login for the SMTP server.

mail_notification_password.label: SMTP password
mail_notification_password.help: The SMTP password. Shown only as set or not set.

autorun_on_torrent_added_enabled.label: Run a program when added
autorun_on_torrent_added_enabled.help: Run the command below each time a torrent is added.

confirm.text: This runs a command every time a torrent is added.

autorun_on_torrent_added_program.label: Command on added
autorun_on_torrent_added_program.help: The command to run. qBittorrent fills in %N (name), %F (content path) and the other % parameters.

confirm.text: This runs this command every time a torrent is added.

autorun_enabled.label: Run a program when finished
autorun_enabled.help: Run the command below each time a torrent finishes.

confirm.text: This runs a command after every torrent finishes.

autorun_program.label: Command on finished
autorun_program.help: The command to run. qBittorrent fills in %N (name), %F (content path) and the other % parameters.

confirm.text: This runs this command after every torrent finishes.

listen_port.label: Port for incoming connections
listen_port.help: The port peers connect to. 0 = random, picked at each start.

confirm.text: Peers and trackers will reach you on the new port; open it in your firewall or VPN if needed.

random_port.label: Random port
random_port.help: Deprecated: reads true when the port is 0. Set the port to 0 instead.

upnp.label: UPnP / NAT-PMP port forwarding
upnp.help: Ask your router to forward the listening port.

confirm.text: This maps ports on your router, outside the VPN tunnel.

ssl_enabled.label: SSL torrents
ssl_enabled.help: Accept SSL torrents on a separate port.

bittorrent_protocol.label: Peer connection protocol
bittorrent_protocol.help: Which protocols qBittorrent uses to talk to peers.

max_connec.label: Global connections
max_connec.help: The most peer connections across all torrents. -1 = unlimited.

max_connec_per_torrent.label: Connections per torrent
max_connec_per_torrent.help: The most peer connections for one torrent. -1 = unlimited.

max_uploads.label: Global upload slots
max_uploads.help: The most peers uploaded to at once, across all torrents. -1 = unlimited.

max_uploads_per_torrent.label: Upload slots per torrent
max_uploads_per_torrent.help: The most peers one torrent uploads to at once. -1 = unlimited.

i2p_enabled.label: I2P
i2p_enabled.help: Connect to peers over the I2P network through a local SAM bridge (experimental).

i2p_address.label: I2P host
i2p_address.help: The host of the I2P SAM bridge.

i2p_port.label: I2P port
i2p_port.help: The port of the I2P SAM bridge.

i2p_mixed_mode.label: I2P mixed mode
i2p_mixed_mode.help: Also use regular peers alongside I2P ones; this gives up I2P's anonymity.

proxy_type.label: Proxy type
proxy_type.help: The proxy qBittorrent connects through. None connects directly.

confirm.text: The new proxy type applies immediately with the current host.

proxy_ip.label: Proxy host
proxy_ip.help: The proxy's host name or IP address.

proxy_password.label: Proxy password
proxy_password.help: The proxy password. Shown only as set or not set.

proxy_hostname_lookup.label: Resolve host names via proxy
proxy_hostname_lookup.help: Look up host names through the proxy instead of locally.

proxy_bittorrent.label: Use proxy for BitTorrent
proxy_bittorrent.help: Send BitTorrent traffic through the proxy.

confirm.text: This sends peer traffic outside the VPN tunnel, through the proxy.

proxy_peer_connections.label: Use proxy for peer connections
proxy_peer_connections.help: Connect to peers through the proxy, not only to trackers.

confirm.text: This sends peer traffic outside the VPN tunnel, through the proxy.

proxy_rss.label: Use proxy for RSS
proxy_rss.help: Fetch RSS feeds through the proxy.

proxy_misc.label: Use proxy for general purposes
proxy_misc.help: Use the proxy for other requests, such as downloading torrent files.

ip_filter_enabled.label: IP filtering
ip_filter_enabled.help: Block peers listed in the filter file.

ip_filter_path.label: Filter file
ip_filter_path.help: A .dat, .p2p or .p2b file of blocked address ranges.

ip_filter_trackers.label: Apply to trackers
ip_filter_trackers.help: Also block trackers whose addresses are in the filter.

banned_IPs.label: Banned IPs
banned_IPs.help: Addresses banned by hand, one per line. Edited in its own section.

dl_limit.label: Download limit
dl_limit.help: The most qBittorrent downloads across all torrents. Type 500K, 2M, or u for unlimited.

up_limit.label: Upload limit
up_limit.help: The most qBittorrent uploads across all torrents. Type 500K, 2M, or u for unlimited.

alt_dl_limit.label: Alternative download limit
alt_dl_limit.help: The download limit while alternative limits are on.

alt_up_limit.label: Alternative upload limit
alt_up_limit.help: The upload limit while alternative limits are on.

scheduler_enabled.label: Schedule alternative limits
scheduler_enabled.help: Switch to the alternative limits between the times below.

schedule_from.label: From
schedule_from.help: When the alternative limits start, as HH:MM.

schedule_to.label: To
schedule_to.help: When the alternative limits end, as HH:MM.

schedule_from_hour.label: From hour
schedule_from_hour.help: The hour of the schedule's start. Written with its minute.

schedule_from_min.label: From minute
schedule_from_min.help: The minute of the schedule's start. Written with its hour.

schedule_to_hour.label: To hour
schedule_to_hour.help: The hour of the schedule's end. Written with its minute.

schedule_to_min.label: To minute
schedule_to_min.help: The minute of the schedule's end. Written with its hour.

limit_utp_rate.label: Apply limits to µTP
limit_utp_rate.help: Count µTP traffic against the speed limits.

limit_tcp_overhead.label: Apply limits to overhead
limit_tcp_overhead.help: Count protocol overhead against the speed limits.

limit_lan_peers.label: Apply limits to LAN peers
limit_lan_peers.help: Count peers on your local network against the speed limits.

dht.label: DHT
dht.help: Find peers through the distributed hash table, without trackers.

confirm.text: Magnets without trackers will stop finding peers.

pex.label: Peer exchange (PeX)
pex.help: Learn about more peers from the peers you're connected to.

confirm.text: Fewer peers will be found through other peers.

lsd.label: Local peer discovery
lsd.help: Find peers on your local network.

confirm.text: No peers will be found on your local network.

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.help: Prefer encrypts when the peer can; Require drops peers that don't; Disable never encrypts.

confirm.text: Peers that don't encrypt are dropped.

anonymous_mode.label: Anonymous mode
anonymous_mode.help: Stop identifying qBittorrent to peers and trackers. See qBittorrent's Anonymous Mode wiki page.

confirm.text: qBittorrent will stop identifying itself; some trackers and peers may refuse you.

max_active_checking_torrents.label: Active checking torrents
max_active_checking_torrents.help: How many torrents are checked at once. -1 = unlimited.

queueing_enabled.label: Torrent queueing
queueing_enabled.help: Limit how many torrents are active; the rest wait in the queue.

max_active_downloads.label: Active downloads
max_active_downloads.help: The most torrents downloading at once. -1 = unlimited.

max_active_uploads.label: Active uploads
max_active_uploads.help: The most torrents seeding at once. -1 = unlimited.

max_active_torrents.label: Active torrents
max_active_torrents.help: The most torrents active at once. -1 = unlimited.

dont_count_slow_torrents.label: Don't count slow torrents
dont_count_slow_torrents.help: Slow torrents don't take a queue slot.

slow_torrent_dl_rate_threshold.label: Slow download threshold
slow_torrent_dl_rate_threshold.help: Below this download rate a torrent counts as slow.

slow_torrent_ul_rate_threshold.label: Slow upload threshold
slow_torrent_ul_rate_threshold.help: Below this upload rate a torrent counts as slow.

slow_torrent_inactive_timer.label: Slow torrent timer
slow_torrent_inactive_timer.help: How long a torrent must stay under the thresholds to count as slow.

max_ratio_enabled.label: Ratio limit on
max_ratio_enabled.help: Reads true when a ratio limit is set. Set the ratio to -1 to turn it off.

max_ratio.label: Ratio limit
max_ratio.help: Stop seeding at this share ratio. -1 = no limit.

max_seeding_time_enabled.label: Seeding time limit on
max_seeding_time_enabled.help: Reads true when a seeding time limit is set. Set it to -1 to turn it off.

max_seeding_time.label: Seeding time limit
max_seeding_time.help: Stop seeding after this many minutes. -1 = no limit.

max_inactive_seeding_time_enabled.label: Inactive seeding limit on
max_inactive_seeding_time_enabled.help: Reads true when an inactive seeding limit is set. Set it to -1 to turn it off.

max_inactive_seeding_time.label: Inactive seeding limit
max_inactive_seeding_time.help: Stop seeding after this many minutes without traffic. -1 = no limit.

max_ratio_act.label: When a limit is reached
max_ratio_act.help: What happens to a torrent that reaches its ratio or seeding limit.

confirm.text: Torrents that reach their share limit will be removed.

byValue.3: Torrents that reach their share limit will be removed with their downloaded files.

add_trackers_enabled.label: Add trackers to new torrents
add_trackers_enabled.help: Append the trackers below to every new torrent.

add_trackers_from_url_enabled.label: Add trackers from a URL
add_trackers_from_url_enabled.help: Append the trackers listed at a URL to every new torrent.

add_trackers_url.label: Tracker list URL
add_trackers_url.help: A URL that serves a tracker list.

add_trackers_url_list.label: Trackers from the URL
add_trackers_url_list.help: The trackers last fetched from the URL. Read-only.

locale.label: Language
locale.help: qBittorrent's interface language, as a locale code such as en or de_DE.

status_bar_external_ip.label: Show external IP in status bar
status_bar_external_ip.help: qBittorrent's own status bar shows your external IP.

confirm_torrent_deletion.label: Confirm torrent deletion
confirm_torrent_deletion.help: qBittorrent's own UI asks before removing a torrent.

file_log_enabled.label: Log to a file
file_log_enabled.help: Write qBittorrent's log to a file.

file_log_path.label: Log folder
file_log_path.help: Where the log file is written.

file_log_backup_enabled.label: Back up the log
file_log_backup_enabled.help: Start a new log file when it reaches the size below.

file_log_max_size.label: Log size
file_log_max_size.help: The size at which a new log file is started.

file_log_delete_old.label: Delete old logs
file_log_delete_old.help: Delete backup logs older than the age below.

file_log_age.label: Log age
file_log_age.help: How old a backup log gets before it's deleted, in the unit below.

file_log_age_type.label: Log age unit
file_log_age_type.help: The unit of the log age.

delete_torrent_content_files.label: Also delete files by default
delete_torrent_content_files.help: Removing a torrent in qBittorrent's own UI deletes its files by default.

web_ui_address.label: Web UI address
web_ui_address.help: OmaqBT talks to qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1. Set by OmaqBT's setup.

web_ui_port.label: Web UI port
web_ui_port.help: OmaqBT talks to qBittorrent on this port. Set by OmaqBT's setup.

web_ui_upnp.label: UPnP for the Web UI port
web_ui_upnp.help: Ask your router to forward the Web UI port.

confirm.text: This exposes the Web UI port to the internet through your router.

use_https.label: Use HTTPS
use_https.help: OmaqBT talks to qBittorrent over plain HTTP on localhost. Locked by OmaqBT.

web_ui_https_cert_path.label: HTTPS certificate
web_ui_https_cert_path.help: Unused while HTTPS is off. Locked by OmaqBT.

web_ui_https_key_path.label: HTTPS key
web_ui_https_key_path.help: Unused while HTTPS is off. Locked by OmaqBT.

web_ui_domain_list.label: Server domains
web_ui_domain_list.help: Host names the Web UI answers to. Locked so OmaqBT can always reach it.

web_ui_username.label: Username
web_ui_username.help: The Web UI login name. At least 3 characters, no colon.

bypass_local_auth.label: Skip login for localhost
bypass_local_auth.help: OmaqBT connects from localhost without a password. Set by OmaqBT's setup.

bypass_auth_subnet_whitelist_enabled.label: Skip login for these subnets
bypass_auth_subnet_whitelist_enabled.help: Clients in the subnets below don't log in.

bypass_auth_subnet_whitelist.label: Subnets
bypass_auth_subnet_whitelist.help: One subnet per line, such as 192.168.0.0/24.

web_ui_max_auth_fail_count.label: Ban after failed logins
web_ui_max_auth_fail_count.help: How many failed logins ban a client. 0 = never.

web_ui_ban_duration.label: Ban duration
web_ui_ban_duration.help: How long a banned client stays banned.

web_ui_session_timeout.label: Session timeout
web_ui_session_timeout.help: How long an idle Web UI session lasts. 0 = no timeout.

web_ui_api_key.label: API key
web_ui_api_key.help: The Web UI API key. Shown only as set or not set; it's rotated from the Web UI.

alternative_webui_enabled.label: Alternative Web UI
alternative_webui_enabled.help: Serve a different Web UI. Locked so OmaqBT keeps the one it talks to.

alternative_webui_path.label: Alternative Web UI files
alternative_webui_path.help: Unused while the alternative Web UI is off. Locked by OmaqBT.

web_ui_clickjacking_protection_enabled.label: Clickjacking protection
web_ui_clickjacking_protection_enabled.help: Stop other sites from framing the Web UI.

web_ui_csrf_protection_enabled.label: CSRF protection
web_ui_csrf_protection_enabled.help: Refuse Web UI requests forged by other sites.

web_ui_secure_cookie_enabled.label: Secure cookie
web_ui_secure_cookie_enabled.help: Mark the session cookie secure (HTTPS only).

web_ui_host_header_validation_enabled.label: Host header validation
web_ui_host_header_validation_enabled.help: Check requests against the server domains. Locked so OmaqBT can always reach it.

web_ui_use_custom_http_headers_enabled.label: Custom HTTP headers
web_ui_use_custom_http_headers_enabled.help: Add the headers below to every Web UI response.

web_ui_custom_http_headers.label: Headers
web_ui_custom_http_headers.help: One header per line, as Name: value.

web_ui_reverse_proxy_enabled.label: Reverse proxy support
web_ui_reverse_proxy_enabled.help: Trust forwarded addresses from the proxies below. Locked by OmaqBT.

web_ui_reverse_proxies_list.label: Trusted proxies
web_ui_reverse_proxies_list.help: Proxy addresses to trust, separated by semicolons. Locked by OmaqBT with reverse proxy support.

dyndns_enabled.label: Update a dynamic DNS name
dyndns_enabled.help: Keep a dynamic DNS name pointed at your IP address.

confirm.text: This publishes your IP address to the DNS service.

dyndns_username.label: Username
dyndns_username.help: The login for the DNS service.

dyndns_password.label: Password
dyndns_password.help: The DNS service password. Shown only as set or not set.

resume_data_storage_type.label: Resume data storage
resume_data_storage_type.help: Where torrent resume data is kept. Requires a qBittorrent restart.

torrent_content_remove_option.label: Removing files
torrent_content_remove_option.help: Whether deleted torrent files are removed for good or moved to the trash.

memory_working_set_limit.label: RAM usage limit
memory_working_set_limit.help: Physical memory limit. qBittorrent doesn't apply it on Linux.

save_resume_data_interval.label: Save resume data every
save_resume_data_interval.help: How often resume data is saved. 0 = never.

save_statistics_interval.label: Save statistics every
save_statistics_interval.help: How often statistics are saved. 0 = never.

torrent_file_size_limit.label: .torrent file size limit
torrent_file_size_limit.help: The largest .torrent file qBittorrent will open, in bytes.

confirm_torrent_recheck.label: Confirm torrent recheck
confirm_torrent_recheck.help: qBittorrent's own UI asks before rechecking.

recheck_completed_torrents.label: Recheck on completion
recheck_completed_torrents.help: Check a torrent's data again when it finishes.

app_instance_name.label: Instance name
app_instance_name.help: A name shown in qBittorrent's title, to tell instances apart.

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval
refresh_interval.help: How often qBittorrent's own UI refreshes.

resolve_peer_host_names.label: Resolve peer host names
resolve_peer_host_names.help: Look up host names for peers' addresses.

resolve_peer_countries.label: Resolve peer countries
resolve_peer_countries.help: Show which country each peer is in.

reannounce_when_address_changed.label: Reannounce on address change
reannounce_when_address_changed.help: Tell all trackers when your IP or port changes.

mark_of_the_web.label: Mark of the Web
mark_of_the_web.help: Tag downloaded files as from the internet. Only used on Windows and macOS.

ignore_ssl_errors.label: Ignore SSL errors
ignore_ssl_errors.help: Skip certificate checks for RSS, torrent downloads and other non-torrent traffic.

python_executable_path.label: Python executable
python_executable_path.help: The Python used for search plugins. Empty = detect it. May need a restart.

current_network_interface.label: Network interface
current_network_interface.help: OmaqBT binds qBittorrent to your VPN interface so traffic never leaves the tunnel. Set by OmaqBT's setup.

current_interface_name.label: Interface name
current_interface_name.help: The bound interface's name, as qBittorrent reports it. Set by OmaqBT's setup.

current_interface_address.label: Interface address
current_interface_address.help: OmaqBT binds to every address on the VPN interface. Set by OmaqBT's setup.

enable_embedded_tracker.label: Embedded tracker
enable_embedded_tracker.help: Run a small BitTorrent tracker inside qBittorrent.

embedded_tracker_port.label: Embedded tracker port
embedded_tracker_port.help: The port the embedded tracker listens on.

embedded_tracker_port_forwarding.label: Forward the tracker port
embedded_tracker_port_forwarding.help: Forward the embedded tracker's port with UPnP.

bdecode_depth_limit.label: Bdecode depth limit
bdecode_depth_limit.help: The deepest nesting accepted when reading torrent data.

bdecode_token_limit.label: Bdecode token limit
bdecode_token_limit.help: The most tokens accepted when reading torrent data.

async_io_threads.label: Asynchronous I/O threads
async_io_threads.help: Threads for disk reads and writes.

file_pool_size.label: File pool size
file_pool_size.help: The most files kept open at once.

disk_queue_size.help: The most bytes waiting to be written to disk.

disk_io_type.help: How libtorrent reads and writes files. Requires a qBittorrent restart.

enable_coalesce_read_write.help: Merge small disk operations. Only used with libtorrent 1.x.

enable_piece_extent_affinity.help: Prefer downloading pieces next to ones already in progress.

send_buffer_watermark_factor.label: Send buffer watermark factor
send_buffer_watermark_factor.help: Scales the send buffer with the upload rate.

socket_backlog_size.label: Socket backlog

block_peers_on_privileged_ports.help: Don't connect to peers on ports below 1024.

upload_slots_behavior.label: Upload slots behaviour
upload_slots_behavior.help: How upload slots are given out.

upload_choking_algorithm.label: Upload choking algorithm
upload_choking_algorithm.help: Which peers seeding torrents upload to.

peer_turnover.label: Peer turnover disconnect
peer_turnover.help: Percentage of peers dropped each interval when a torrent is at its limit.

peer_turnover_cutoff.label: Peer turnover threshold
peer_turnover_cutoff.help: Turnover starts when a torrent's peers pass this percentage of its limit.

request_queue_size.label: Max outstanding requests
request_queue_size.help: The most block requests queued to one peer.

announce_to_all_trackers.label: Announce to all trackers in a tier
announce_to_all_trackers.help: Announce to every tracker in a tier, not only the first that works.

announce_to_all_tiers.label: Announce to all tiers
announce_to_all_tiers.help: Announce to one tracker in every tier.

announce_ip.label: IP reported to trackers
announce_ip.help: The IP address to announce instead of your own; it must be an IP address. Requires a qBittorrent restart.

announce_port.label: Port reported to trackers
announce_port.help: The port to announce. 0 = the listening port. Requires a qBittorrent restart.

max_concurrent_http_announces.label: Concurrent HTTP announces
max_concurrent_http_announces.help: The most HTTP tracker announces at once.

stop_tracker_timeout.label: Stop tracker timeout
stop_tracker_timeout.help: How long to wait for trackers when stopping. 0 = don't wait.

dht_bootstrap_nodes.label: DHT bootstrap nodes
dht_bootstrap_nodes.help: Nodes used to join the DHT, as host:port separated by commas.

i2p_inbound_length.label: I2P inbound length
i2p_inbound_length.help: Hops in each inbound I2P tunnel.

i2p_outbound_length.label: I2P outbound length
i2p_outbound_length.help: Hops in each outbound I2P tunnel.

rss_refresh_interval.label: Feed refresh interval
rss_refresh_interval.help: How often feeds are fetched. Slice 5.

rss_fetch_delay.label: Feed fetch delay
rss_fetch_delay.help: The wait between fetches from one host. Slice 5.

rss_max_articles_per_feed.label: Articles per feed
rss_max_articles_per_feed.help: The most articles kept per feed. Slice 5.

rss_auto_downloading_enabled.label: RSS auto-downloading
rss_auto_downloading_enabled.help: Download torrents from feeds by rule. Slice 5.

rss_download_repack_proper_episodes.label: Download REPACK/PROPER
rss_download_repack_proper_episodes.help: Also download REPACK and PROPER episodes. Slice 5.

rss_smart_episode_filters.label: Smart episode filters
rss_smart_episode_filters.help: Patterns that find episode numbers, one per line. Slice 5.
